page.overview:
Who is Virudhaka?

When Sun Wukong was given an official position, he somersaulted up to Heaven faster than the Great White Golden Star could follow. Not recognising him, Virudhaka and his soldiers Liu, Gou, Bi, Deng, Xin, Zhang, and Tao refused to let him through the Southern Heavenly Gate until the Great White Golden Star arrived and cleared up the situation.
